content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-trap-most-4|COREMERCH guide to creators]] in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-which-architecture-actually-works-7|Stripe Alternatives]] for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you-3|payment]]s, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an automated delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Selling digital products without relying on traditional payment platforms is crucial for creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Venezuela. Traditional platforms often impose high fees and restrictions, effectively locking creators out of the global market. A solution based on Solana payments offers lower transaction fees—NOWPayments charges just 0.5% compared to the 10% charged by platforms like Gumroad. This difference can mean retaining up to $921 per month on a $97 product with 100 sales, allowing creators to reinvest in their businesses and continue innovating.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The foundation of using Solana payments for digital products lies in a decentralized architecture that leverages blockchain technology. By integrating NOWPayments with your solution, you ensure that transactions are processed with minimal fees and without the need for a middleman. The use of tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script facilitates automated delivery of digital products, ensuring buyers receive their purchases instantly. With full data ownership and no dependence on conventional platforms, creators gain the freedom to run their businesses on their terms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is specifically designed for digital creators in underserved markets. It enables them to sell a wide range of products, from ebooks to software, without the constraints imposed by major payment processors. Creators in countries like Kenya, Bangladesh, and Zimbabwe can take advantage of the straightforward deployment process, allowing them to focus on creating quality content without worrying about payment rejections or high fees. By adopting this infrastructure, creators can thrive and grow their businesses sustainably.
NOWPayments offers the lowest fees—just 0.5% per transaction.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce stack comprises various free tools and services that work synergistically. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the hosting platform, while backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Order storage can be managed with Supabase or Google Sheets, and digital products are delivered through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. NOWPayments ensures that crypto payments are seamless and efficient, providing real-time pricing in USD at the moment of transaction. This combination empowers creators to build a fully functional online store that they own outright.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start deploying your sovereign commerce infrastructure today, first select the appropriate stack based on your product offerings. Utilize GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your site. Implement backend logic through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage orders. Choose Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Set up Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. For a comprehensive guide, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all the necessary blueprints and templates.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
You own your digital store entirely, with no reliance on third-party platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
